mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, email, password_hash, display_name, bio, avatar_url, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{bio}, #{avatarUrl}, now(), now())
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.bio, u.avatar_url, COALESCE(fg.count, 0) AS following_count, COALESCE(fr.count, 0) AS follower_count, (cf.follower_id IS NOT NULL) AS followed_by_current_user FROM users u LEFT JOIN (SELECT follower_id, COUNT(*) AS count FROM follows GROUP BY follower_id) fg ON fg.follower_id = u.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT followee_id, COUNT(*) AS count FROM follows GROUP BY followee_id) fr ON fr.followee_id = u.id LEFT JOIN follows cf ON cf.followee_id = u.id AND cf.follower_id = #{currentUserId} WHERE u.username = #{username}

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.avatar_url, (cf.follower_id IS NOT NULL) AS followed_by_current_user FROM users u LEFT JOIN follows cf ON cf.follower_id = #{currentUserId} AND cf.followee_id = u.id WHERE u.id != #{currentUserId} AND (u.username ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.display_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY u.username ASC LIMIT #{limit}
